# Construction Programme Features: <span class="highlight">Gantt, Critical Path and Voice</span>

<div class="section section-light" id="programme">
<div class="container">

<h2 class="section-title">Construction <span>Programme</span></h2>

<p class="text-center mb-4" style="max-width: 750px; margin: 0 auto 3rem;">
Critical path, Gantt, baselines and progress in the browser, with nothing to install. <strong>Included in every plan</strong>—the plan sets how many programmes, baselines and imports you get.
</p>

<div class="grid-2">

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i> Critical Path Scheduling</h3>
<p>Dates are calculated by the critical path method on the programme calendar, with working days and holidays. See straight away which tasks drive your finish date.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Critical tasks marked on the Gantt</li>
<li>Total float and free float columns</li>
<li>Finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish and start-to-finish links with lags</li>
<li>Deadlines that warn when they are missed</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-bar-chart-steps"></i> Gantt and Keyboard Grid</h3>
<p>Build and change the programme with the mouse or the keyboard. The task grid works like MS Project.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Drag bars on the Gantt to move, stretch and link tasks</li>
<li>Type links as <code>3, 5SS+2d</code> and durations as <code>2w</code> or <code>2ed</code></li>
<li>Edit several tasks in one step</li>
<li>Undo and redo</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-list-nested"></i> Structure, Constraints and Calendars</h3>
<p>Model the programme the way you plan it, from the WBS down to individual milestones.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>8 constraint types: as soon as possible, as late as possible, start or finish no earlier or no later than, must start or finish on</li>
<li>Deadlines, milestones and hammock tasks</li>
<li>WBS structure with indent and outdent</li>
<li>Project calendar with holidays and site shutdowns</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-flag"></i> Baselines and Progress</h3>
<p>Know where you are against the programme you agreed, and show it clearly at the next progress meeting.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Save baselines and compare with a baseline or a saved version</li>
<li>Baseline bars and finish variance on the Gantt</li>
<li>Progress by status date, percent complete and actual dates</li>
<li>Progress line that shows tasks behind or ahead</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-shield-check"></i> Validate</h3>
<p>Check programme quality before you issue it, so logic problems do not reach the client.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Open ends</li>
<li>Negative float</li>
<li>Constraints that fight the logic</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-people"></i> Built for the Team</h3>
<p>Keep every programme for a job in one place and see who changed what.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Several programmes per project, with one marked current</li>
<li>Multi-user, with full change history</li>
<li>Conflict protection when two people edit the same programme</li>
<li>Custom fields and activity codes</li>
</ul>
</div>

</div>

<p class="text-center" style="max-width: 750px; margin: 2rem auto 0; color: #757575;">
<strong>Limits, stated plainly:</strong> the programme has no resource or cost loading. Each programme holds up to 2,000 tasks (150 on the Free plan). There is no native .mpp or .pp export. <a href="pricing.html">See programme limits by plan</a>.
</p>

</div>
</div>

<h3 class="text-center" style="margin: 3rem 0 1.5rem;">How to import an MS Project, Asta or Primavera programme</h3>

<div class="feature-card">

<div class="feature-card">

<h2 class="section-title" id="ai-assistant">Voice and <span>AI Assistant</span></h2>

<p class="text-center mb-4" style="max-width: 750px; margin: 0 auto 2rem;">
Say what you want to change the way you would say it on site, or type it. The programme assistant makes the change, explains the result on screen, and you can undo ordinary edits. It is on every plan; the plan sets how many requests you get.
</p>

<div class="grid-2">

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-mic"></i> Just Say It</h3>
<ul style="color: #757575; list-style: none; padding: 0; line-height: 1.9;">
<li>“Create a programme starting next Monday: groundworks 3 weeks, then frame 8 weeks, then fit-out 6 weeks.”</li>
<li>“Push frame out a week.”</li>
<li>“Piling can't start before 3 March.”</li>
<li>“What's driving the finish?”</li>
<li>“Shut the site for Christmas.”</li>
<li>“Baseline this as the contract programme.”</li>
<li>“Piling started on 3 March and is 60% done.”</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-soundwave"></i> How Voice Works</h3>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Click the microphone in the assistant panel and speak</li>
<li>Your words appear as a live transcript you can edit</li>
<li>After a short pause, a visible countdown runs and the request is sent</li>
<li>Correct yourself as you speak: “ten days, no, twelve”</li>
<li>Replies appear on screen</li>
<li>Works in Chrome, Edge and Safari with an internet connection</li>
<li>English and Polish</li>
<li>Typing always works too</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-chat-dots"></i> What the Assistant Does</h3>
<p>18 programme tools, from building a programme to exporting it.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Builds a programme from a spoken or typed description, asks for missing durations and lists every assumption</li>
<li>Edits many tasks in one request (up to 200 changes)</li>
<li>Explains the critical path and driving predecessors, and lists tasks by float</li>
<li>Sets links, calendars and holidays, baselines, custom fields and activity codes</li>
<li>Compares with a baseline or saved version, validates, imports and exports XML or XER</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-arrow-counterclockwise"></i> You Stay in Control</h3>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Ordinary edits apply at once, and you can undo the last 25 steps</li>
<li>Larger or destructive changes are proposed first and run only when you confirm: deleting more than 10 tasks, imports, restores, deleting a programme or field, and changing the current programme</li>
<li>Confirm by voice with “yes” or “go ahead”; cancel with “no” or “cancel”</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Praevius and <span>MS Project, Asta, Primavera</span></h2>

<p class="text-center mb-4" style="max-width: 750px; margin: 0 auto 3rem;">

</p>

<div class="grid-2">

<div class="feature-card">

<div class="section section-light">
<div class="container">

<h2 class="section-title">Frequently Asked <span>Questions</span></h2>

<div style="max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto;">

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>Can Praevius replace MS Project, Asta or Primavera for my programme?</h3>
<p>For subcontractor, package and mid-size main-contractor programmes, it often can. Praevius gives you critical path scheduling with total and free float, a Gantt chart, 8 constraint types, deadlines, milestones, baselines and progress against a status date, in the browser with nothing to install. You import MS Project, Asta Powerproject or Primavera files and export MS Project XML or Primavera XER, so you can still exchange programmes with the main contractor. It does not do resource or cost loading, and a programme holds up to 2,000 tasks (150 on the Free plan). If you need resource levelling, cost-loaded programmes or very large P6 programmes, keep your current tool for that work.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>Can I import an .xer or .pp file without Primavera or Asta?</h3>
<p>Yes. Upload the Primavera .xer or Asta Powerproject .pp file itself; you do not need Primavera or Asta on your computer. Praevius also imports MS Project .mpp and MS Project .xml files. Files can be up to 20 MB, with up to 2,000 tasks and 3,000 links. Before you confirm, an import report shows the task and link counts, how many dates move and what could not be carried.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>Can I export back to MS Project or Primavera?</h3>
<p>Yes. Praevius exports MS Project XML and Primavera XER, plus PDF (A3) and Excel. An export report lists anything the format could not carry: for XML, hammocks and activity codes (written as text); for XER, elapsed durations and lags. Praevius does not export native .mpp or .pp files. Asta Powerproject can import the MS Project XML, and it may convert the calendars.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>What happens to my programme when I import it?</h3>
<p>Each import arrives as a new draft programme and never overwrites an existing one. Praevius keeps the WBS, finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish and start-to-finish links with lags, 8 constraint types, deadlines, milestones, notes, the project calendar and holidays, progress, hammocks, activity codes and custom fields. It does not keep task calendars, split tasks, percentage lags, resources and costs, P6 secondary constraints, links to tasks outside the file or baselines stored in the file. Links on summary tasks are moved or dropped. The import report lists every item that was not carried.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>How does voice input work?</h3>
<p>Click the microphone in the assistant panel and speak. Your words appear as a live transcript that you can edit. After a short pause, a visible countdown runs and the request is sent. You can correct yourself as you speak, for example “ten days, no, twelve”. The assistant replies on screen. Typing always works as well as voice.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>Which browsers and languages does voice support?</h3>
<p>Voice input uses the speech recognition in Chrome, Edge and Safari, and needs an internet connection. It does not work in Firefox; you can type your request instead. Voice understands English and Polish.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>Does the AI assistant change my programme without asking?</h3>
<p>Ordinary edits apply at once and you can undo the last 25 steps. Larger or destructive changes are proposed first and run only when you confirm: deleting more than 10 tasks, imports, restores, deleting a programme or a field, and changing the current programme. You can confirm by voice with “yes” or “go ahead”, or cancel with “no” or “cancel”.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>What is the Praevius MCP server?</h3>
<p>The Praevius MCP server lets you connect your own AI agent to Praevius. Agent access is available over MCP with OAuth sign-in; read on every plan, write actions need Professional or Scale and your confirmation.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>How does construction variance tracking work?</h3>
<p>The Cost Control module compares budgeted and actual project costs. When costs move away from the budget, a traffic-light status shows it: green within ±5%, yellow at 5–10% variance and red over 10%. Cost Control is on the Essential, Professional and Scale plans.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>How does construction change order management work?</h3>
<p>Praevius tracks every variation from inception to approval to payment in a variation register with status tracking, entitlement flagging, impact assessment and pricing tools, and an approval workflow. It is part of the Cost Control module on Essential and above.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>What is progress claim automation?</h3>
<p>Progress claim automation takes the manual work out of payment applications. Praevius calculates percentage complete from your budget data, tracks retention, keeps an audit trail and exports claims in UK JCT, Australian SOPA and US AIA G702/G703 formats. It is part of the Cost Control module on Essential and above.</p>
</div>

</div>
